displayDescription: Sticker explainer: a question, idea, links and system are pressed onto a sky-blue dotted field while a copper idea chip travels along the connectors.
styleRenderer: SVG (inline vector stickers, masks, real text)
motionEngine: Time-derived SVG chip renderer driven by timeline time
limitations: Stickers are flat vector approximations of physical stickers. The white border, soft drop shadow and the lift-and-press motion suggest a sticker but are not paper or vinyl simulations, and there is no real peel deformation.

The sky-blue field #C9E0E8 is a new scene-dependent background, taken from the reviewed source's 'networking/communication' chapter option. The ink, white, teal and copper concept colours are unchanged.
Legend lettering on the copper and teal pills is about 3.8:1, which meets the large-text 3:1 threshold but not 4.5:1.
Rendering, contrast and layout were not verified by the agent. The host runs those checks.
No preview recipe was supplied, so none is demonstrated. Rough.js, PixiJS, mo.js and the other installed pool libraries were not needed for this flat sticker medium.

The headline, '?' and pill labels use the macOS system font Arial Rounded MT Bold (/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial Rounded Bold.ttf), declared with @font-face local(). On machines without it, they fall back to Arial bold.
